summary: Karpathy introduced 'agentic engineering' at Sequoia Ascent 2026, distinguishing it from vibe coding via spec design, diff review, and eval loops. Also published an LLM Wiki gist proposing persistent structured Markdown wikis instead of live RAG. He joined Anthropic's pretraining team.
relevanceToAgentForge: Medium — the eval-loop and diff-review concepts align with AgentForge's plan-review stages, but the LLM Wiki pattern is already partially addressed by skill distillation (distillationAgent.ts). No new verified gap.

summary: Karpathy published 9 rules for autonomous agents shifting execution and bookkeeping to AI models, with loops, planning, generation, review, and on-disk state management.
relevanceToAgentForge: Medium — maps conceptually to AgentForge's state machine but doesn't add a verified missing capability. Backlog at 11 issues (>= 10 cap).

source: GitHub HydraFusion — GitHub Copilot multi-model orchestration preview
summary: GitHub's Project HydraFusion (research preview Sep 4 2026 in Copilot CLI) combines multiple LLMs to reduce costs, secure agent behaviour, surface specialized data, and improve developer collaboration.
relevanceToAgentForge: Low — product feature inside GitHub's closed ecosystem; model routing already shipped in agentModels.ts. Not an open pattern AgentForge can adopt.

source: Regimes / ActiveGraph — auditable improvement loop on LongMemEval (arXiv 2606.10241)
summary: Regimes is an auditable, held-out-gated self-improvement loop built on ActiveGraph, an event-sourced runtime with determinism contract and content-addressed model-call cache. Demonstrated on LongMemEval.
relevanceToAgentForge: Low — event-sourcing rewrite is explicitly a red flag in the evaluation criteria; determinism already provided by the state machine. Backlog full regardless.

source: RaMem: Contextual Reinstatement for Long-term Agentic Memory (arXiv 2606.22844)
summary: RaMem proposes multi-scope memory tagging (user_id, agent_id, run_id, session_id) and contextual reinstatement to avoid context collapse in long-lived agents.
relevanceToAgentForge: High — directly relevant to HID-188 (cross-run episodic memory). Already tracked.

source: Mem0 — State of AI Agent Memory 2026 Report
summary: Industry report on memory architecture trends: multi-scope tagging, staleness management, and context collapse as the primary failure mode for agent memory systems in 2026.
relevanceToAgentForge: High — maps to HID-188 (episodic memory), already tracked. No new gap.

source: LangGraph Memory Deep Dive: Short-Term Checkpoints to Self-Updating Agents (Medium / Sahin Ahmed 2026)
summary: LangGraph enables stateful agents with short-term in-context memory and long-term cross-session memory via external vector stores; demonstrates self-updating agent patterns.
relevanceToAgentForge: High — episodic/cross-session memory maps to HID-188. Skill distillation (distillationAgent.ts) already covers procedural memory; run-outcome episodic memory gap tracked by HID-188.

source: Microsoft Agent Framework 1.0 (April 2026) — merger of AutoGen + Semantic Kernel
summary: Microsoft merged AutoGen and Semantic Kernel into Microsoft Agent Framework 1.0 (shipped April 2026). AutoGen is now in maintenance mode.
relevanceToAgentForge: Low — different ecosystem (.NET/Python), no directly adoptable patterns for AgentForge's Node.js/TypeScript stack.

source: CrewAI 1.14 — standalone, A2A protocol, MCP integration (2026)
summary: CrewAI 1.14 dropped LangChain dependency (fully standalone), added Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol compatibility and MCP integration. Also added async crew runner and Flows event-driven pipeline mode.
relevanceToAgentForge: Low — CrewAI is a separate framework; A2A protocol and MCP are interesting but AgentForge uses CLI-subprocess model, not API-to-agent communication. No verified gap to fill.

source: Dyna-Think: Synergizing Reasoning, Acting, and World Model Simulation in AI Agents (arXiv 2506.00320)
summary: Dyna-Think integrates a world-model simulation step into agent reasoning cycles, enabling agents to mentally simulate action outcomes before executing. Extends ReAct with predictive planning.
relevanceToAgentForge: Low — speculative execution / predictive planning is deliberately rejected per Phase 3 red flags. No verified gap.
